title: Groam release environments
description: Public settings for the hosted environment. Secrets never go here; they live in the matching GitHub environment. An empty convexUrl or emailFrom means not configured yet; `just deploy preflight` rejects it. An empty host is valid.

convexUrl.description: The Convex production deployment URL, from the project's dashboard.

host.description: Optional custom domain attached to the Convex deployment (intended: groam.app). Empty means the release serves from the deployment's own HTTP origin (the convexUrl with .convex.cloud replaced by .convex.site). When set it must be a bare hostname, never a Convex one; it serves the landing site at / and the web app at /app/.

emailFrom.description: Sender of authentication mail, optionally with a display name; Resend sends from it, so its domain must be verified there.
